plain: A model whose trained parameters are published, so anyone can download, run and change it.
eli5: A recipe that anyone can copy and change, not just a cake you can buy at the shop.
technical: Release of a model's weights for download; once published, no update or takedown reaches existing copies, and anyone can fine-tune, ablate or abliterate its safeguards, so release risk is assessed against what the modified model can do.
